name: gstack
title_zh: 技能太多找不到？它给你一张按场景排好的索引卡
tagline_zh: 装了一堆 gstack 技能后，每次开工都要翻半天？它把「哪个场景该调哪个技能」编成一张可检索的目录。
tagline_en: Tired of digging through your gstack skills before starting? This turns 'which skill for this task' into a.
desc_en: Router for the gstack skill suite. (gstack)
why_zh: 它不执行任务，只做路由：按你描述的场景，从已装技能里挑出最匹配的那一个。
why_en: It doesn't do the work—it routes. Given your scenario, it picks the best installed skill. The win is killing the hidden cost of.
limit_zh: 只对 gstack 技能套件内的技能生效；非本套件技能不会出现在索引里。它不解释技能用法，只负责指路。
title_en: A scene-based index card for your gstack skills
limit_en: Only indexes skills within the gstack suite. It won't explain how to use a skill—just points you to it. Actual execution is still on you.
